evidence.quote: Whether the folding agent can benefit from parallel branching — i.e., creating multiple sub-branches that run simultaneously — remains an open question.
Other tasks with a breadth-first structure (eg WideSearch) may be more promising for studying parallelism in LLM agents.
Several promising future directions include multi-layer context folding, which develops hierarchical folding strategies where folds themselves can be further folded for deeper compression.
